name: MY AVA All in Family Hotel
beschreibung: The MY AVA All in Family Hotel is located in Tirol, Österreich, in a quiet location with views of the Alpen. The accommodation is designed as a family hotel and offers spacious rooms as well as a kids' club. Amenities include a wellness area and a playground. The atmosphere is relaxed and tailored to the needs of families. The culinary offering includes regional specialties and children's menus. Hiking trails and winter sports opportunities are available in the surrounding area. The hotel is particularly suitable for families with children.
